h: Pat Utomi dares Tinubu to defend his record in a live presidential debate
p: Political economist Pat Utomi has challenged President Tinubu to take part in a live debate and defend his achievements before the 2027 election. There was no immediate response from the presidency.
more: Debate calls are growing as the campaign season opens.
Polling day has been set for February 2027.
